title: A relative finitely presented right factor descends after the coefficient structure
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $i_0\in I$. Let $B_0,C_0$ be commutative $F(i_0)$-algebras and $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ an algebra map. Put $B_i=F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, $C_i=F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$ for $i\ge i_0$, and $B=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$, with canonical maps $\mu_{B,i}$ and $\mu_{C,i}$ and $\varphi_i=\mathrm{id}_{F(i)}\otimes\varphi_0$, $\varphi=\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0$. Let $P,Q$ be commutative rings, $Q$ a finitely presented $P$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and give $B$ a $P$-algebra structure. Suppose $j\ge i_0$ and $B_j$ has a $P$-algebra structure for which $\mu_{B,j}$ is $P$-linear. If $f:Q\to C$ is a ring map satisfying $f\circ\mathrm{alg}_Q=\varphi\circ\mathrm{alg}_B$, then there are $i\ge i_0$, a $P$-structure on $B_i$ with $\mu_{B,i}$ $P$-linear, and a ring map $q:Q\to C_i$ such that $q\circ\mathrm{alg}_Q=\varphi_i\circ\mathrm{alg}_{B_i}$ and $\mu_{C,i}\circ q=f$.

proof.text: On the upper tail of j, explicitly transport P → Bⱼ to Bᵢ through the tensor transition maps, and compose with φᵢ to obtain P → Cᵢ. Tensor induction proves the transition laws, the squares with φ₀, and compatibility with the canonical maps. The supplied μBj and its compatibility prove that μBᵢ is P-linear, and the square with φ₀ proves that μCᵢ and the C transitions are P-linear. The condition on f makes it a P-algebra map.

proof.text: Represent elements of C using the elementwise base-change lemma and move representatives past j using directedness. The same lemma gives eventual vanishing in this tail. Choose a finite polynomial presentation of Q over P. Lift its variables at one common stage and evaluate using the transported P-structure. Constants agree after mapping to C by P-linearity; variables agree by choice; polynomial extensionality gives equality on every polynomial.

proof.text: Each finite kernel generator evaluates to an element zero in C, so choose a common later stage where every generator vanishes. Descend evaluation through the surjective polynomial presentation. The resulting q factors f by surjectivity. For P-linearity compare a representative of algebraMap P Q r with the constant polynomial r: their difference lies in the kernel, so both evaluations agree, and P-linearity of the transition gives q(algebraMap P Q r) = algebraMap P Cᵢ r. Retain the explicit Bᵢ algebra structure and its P-linear coprojection.

theorem exists_tensor_right_factor_finite_stage
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (j : I) (hj : i₀ ≤ j)
    (aPj : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hj)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj j) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (μBj : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hj)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPj
      letI := aP
      (↥(F.obj j) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P] (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hμBj : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hj)).hom.toAlgebra
      let αj : F.obj j →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F j).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hj)) }
      μBj.toRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)
    (f : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Q →+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (hf : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      f.comp (algebraMap P Q) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId ↥(colimit F) ↥(colimit F)) φ₀).toRingHom.comp
          (algebraMap P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))) :
    ∃ (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i),
    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
    let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
      { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
        commutes' := fun s ↦
          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
    ∃ (aPi : Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      ∃ (μB : (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
          (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        μB.toRingHom =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom ∧
        ∃ (q : Q →+* (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
          q.comp (algebraMap P Q) =
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj i) (F.obj i)) φ₀).toRingHom.comp
              (algebraMap P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)) ∧
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp q = f
